when.en: One feature needs both a backend contract and a new frontend surface; the surface is generated against the filled contract after the architecture is decided.
when.vi: Một feature cần cả contract backend lẫn bề mặt frontend mới; bề mặt được sinh dựa trên contract đã điền sau khi kiến trúc đã quyết.

mission.goal: one feature lands end to end: contract, surface, proof, promise, publication

doneWhen.evidence: the promise is modelled and published
the backend contract is filled on the session branch
the surface is committed on the session branch
the committed head is served on the product port
the served surface passes the audit with its screenshots kept
a person's journey completes on the served surface
the promise is reconciled against the delivered feature
the session branch is merged and pushed

rewrite: backend.source.apply → backend.generate; frontend trio → interface.generate; post-write bind → runtime.serve; frontend.surface.audit → interface.audit; business.decide (reconcile) → business.reconcile. The two side-by-side steps of the 2.0.0 example are gone: interface.generate reads the filled contract (an optional Input the planner orders after its in-chain producer), and one quality.verify measures the merged head instead of two.
